title: The registry of named forms
description: The classes of functional form this bench enumerates over, as a file an engine in any language can read. Every robustness claim the bench makes is a claim about these expressions: a conclusion that survived a hundred form combinations survived a particular hundred, and `tag` is what lets a reader comparing two runs know whether they were the same hundred. Generated from docs/bench/core/forms.js by scripts/forms_json.mjs and held to it by tests/forms.test.mjs, so the file and the module cannot drift.

tag.description: A short deterministic digest over every family name, its declared properties and its member expressions, with the family and member counts after it. A result, a proof or a deposit cites this to say WHICH registry it was computed over. Not a cryptographic digest and not pretending to be one: it answers whether two runs used the same registry, and it answers it synchronously, which is what lets it travel in a render.

properties.description: What a scholar can declare about a shape. A class is conjunctive: a family serves it only where the family's own properties carry every one of them.
What every member of this family is claimed to have. A family whose members do not have the properties it claims is not a class, it is a list.

expr.description: The member in the bench grammar, with X for what the term reads. The grammar is + - * / ** and exp log min max, and nothing else, so the same string runs in the page, under node, and in any engine that implements eight operators.
